    Retained mesh coefficients at t = 1 (Proposition 12.8, mesh presentations) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Lift the arrows using these bases. In each path degree q ≥ 3, decompose their current mesh errors into the image of the original derivative and the span of the retained p_i of that degree. The chosen splitting removes the image part by an arrow correction of degree q − 1. […] these corrections do not change earlier coefficients, so the procedure is triangular and finite. It produces polynomials F_i(t) in the mesh relations."

    At the fibre t = 1: lifted arrows (ArrowL) are realized on paths (pathR); their realizations have the expected order, leading term, weights in the cone and bottom part (pathR_props).
